language.title: Language
language.body: The language the app displays in. What you have captured stays as it is.

actions.signOutHint: Signs out and returns to the sign-in screen.
actions.deleteJournalsHint: Opens a confirmation before deleting every journal entry.
actions.deleteNotesHint: Opens a confirmation before deleting every note.
actions.deleteAuditHint: Opens a confirmation before deleting every audit response.
actions.deleteBfiHint: Opens a confirmation before deleting saved Big Five results.
actions.deleteEcrHint: Opens a confirmation before deleting saved Attachment results.
actions.deleteMbtiHint: Opens a confirmation before deleting saved MBTI reference results.
actions.deleteWikiHint: Opens a confirmation before deleting every wiki page.
actions.deleteUningestedHint: Opens a confirmation before deleting captures not yet promoted to wiki.
actions.resetUsageHint: Opens a confirmation before resetting daily usage counters.
actions.fullWipeInputLabel: Full wipe confirmation. Type {{phrase}} to enable the delete button.
actions.fullWipeHint: Requires typed DELETE confirmation before wiping records, sources, wiki pages, and usage.

dataWizard.body: Choose one deletion area at a time. Your private 2nd-B content stays split into records, assessments, wiki/captures, and full wipe.
dataWizard.selectedHint: This deletion area is already selected. Its actions are shown below.

records.label: Records
records.hint: Shows deletion actions for journals, notes, and audit responses.
records.body: Clear one private record type while keeping the rest of your graph and wiki intact.

assessments.label: Assessments
assessments.hint: Shows deletion actions for saved assessment results.
assessments.body: Remove saved reference results without touching journals, captures, or wiki pages.

library.label: Wiki and captures
library.hint: Shows deletion actions for wiki pages, un-ingested captures, and usage counters.
library.body: Clean wiki and capture surfaces separately from private records and shared graph references.

full.label: Full wipe
full.hint: Shows the typed confirmation for deleting all records, sources, wiki pages, and usage.
full.body: This is the irreversible content-wipe path. Export first, then type DELETE only if you are sure.
full.retained: This clears private 2nd-B content in this account. Account details, consent history, and service accountability records stay.

deletionUndo: Deletion cannot be undone. Export anything you need first.
subtitleFull: Tune your settings. Deletion cannot be undone. Export anything you need first.
autoTaggingDesc: Sort into stars and tags on capture
suggestionAlertsDesc: Ping me when a new insight lands
onDeviceFirstDesc: Analyze raw text only on device
callRecordingDesc: Transcribe calls on device; SecondB weaves them into stars.
googleCalendarDesc: Rhythm and relationship signals from events
appleHealthDesc: Sleep and activity for the health star
manageIntegrationsDesc: Per-source import for calendar, health, Notion and more
importDataDesc: Paste or pick an exported file to turn it into records
workingPaused: Working on it. Other actions and sign-out are paused until this finishes.
resetCoachmarksDesc: Replay the home guide from the start
partialByKindDesc: Delete one kind only. Other kinds and your wiki stay.
delBigFiveDesc: Delete every saved BFI-44 result. Include older TIPI records if present.
delMbtiDesc: Delete every saved MBTI reference result.
delAllWikiDesc: Wiki pages and their page-to-page links are wiped. Inbox sources stay.
delUningestedDesc: Only sources that haven't been promoted to a wiki page.
resetDailyDesc: Clear today's and all past usage counters.
dangerFullWipeDesc: Wipes records, sources, wiki pages, and SecondB usage in one shot. The account stays but you start from zero.
cannotUndoExport: This cannot be undone. Export anything you need first.
finalCheck: Final check: everything will be gone. Did you export first?
signOutError: Something went wrong while signing out. Please try again in a moment.
wipeComplete: Full wipe complete: records {{r}} · sources {{s}} · wiki {{w}} · usage {{u}}

subscription.title: Manage subscription
subscription.judgeComp: Paid features are open on this judge account at no charge.
subscription.freeBody: You are on the free plan, so there is no active paid subscription.
subscription.loadFailed: Could not load your subscription details.
subscription.supportLine: Need a hand? Write to {{email}} and we reply within 2 business days.

cancel.title: Cancel subscription
cancel.body: Your subscription renews automatically until you cancel. Cancelling stops the next charge and keeps your paid features until the period you already paid for ends.
cancel.unavailable: This subscription cannot be cancelled from the app. If you bought it through a store, cancel it in that store's subscription settings.
cancel.confirmAtRenewal: It will not renew after {{date}}. Paid features stay open until then.
cancel.confirmImmediate: Paid features close right away, and the remaining time is not refunded automatically.
cancel.switchToRenewal: Cancel at the next renewal instead
cancel.periodEnd: the end of the paid period
cancel.alreadyScheduled: Auto-renewal is already off for this subscription. Nothing more will be charged, and paid features stay open until the paid period ends.

refund.title: Refund
refund.confirmBody: The request goes to Paddle, the seller of record. If Paddle approves it, the full amount returns to your original payment method. This does not cancel the subscription on its own, so cancel it too if you want the billing to stop.

reason.eligible: You can request a full refund right now.
reason.usedBeyondFree: Usage since the payment went past what the free plan covers over the same span, so self-serve refund is not available.
reason.windowPassed: More than 7 days have passed since the payment, so self-serve refund is not available.
reason.noPayment: There is no payment on record to refund.
reason.unknown: We could not check refund eligibility.

refund.usage: Reasoning used: {{used}} (the free plan allows {{allowance}} over the same span)
refund.beforeEffective: The revised refund terms take effect on 8 September 2026. Until then the current policy applies: a full refund within 30 days of payment, no questions asked, requested by email.

notice.cancelledAtRenewal: Cancellation is scheduled for the next renewal date.
notice.refundRequested: Your refund request was submitted to Paddle. The decision arrives by email from the payment receipt address. Cancel the subscription separately if you also want the billing to stop.
notice.alreadyRequested: A request is already on file, so nothing was submitted twice.
notice.refundRejected: Self-serve refund is not available for this payment.
notice.contactSupport: This cannot be handled in the app right now. Please contact support.
notice.notSubscribed: There is no active paid subscription to cancel.
notice.dryRun: Rehearsal mode is on, so nothing was sent to Paddle. Contact support if you meant to submit this.
notice.policyNotInEffect: The revised refund terms are not in effect yet. Please request a refund by email for now.

subscription.cancelScheduledOn: Auto-renewal is off. Paid features stay open until {{date}}.
